title: Harnessing a 256-qubit Neutral Atom Simulator for Graph Classification
summary: Neutral atom platforms are analogue quantum simulators that offer the possibility to map graphs onto a 2D qubit register using programmable Rubidium atoms arrays, whose valence electrons' energy state is used as qubits, using optical tweezers. This makes it possible to implement algorithms for solving graph combinatorial optimization and Quantum Machine Learning (QML) tasks, such as graph classification.
